rationale: The bounce off entry stalled right at the 9-EMA ($54.54) and rolled back down without touching the $54.68 invalidation, leaving the bearish structure intact — price is still well below VWAP ($55.16), the tape stays risk-off (SPY -0.74%, VIXY +3.01%), and 6.75x RVOL continues. The trade is only one minute old with the original thesis unbroken, and remaining risk to the stop (~$87 beyond the current mark, ~$142 total) fits inside the $282 budget with a roughly 3:1 reward-to-risk path to $53.10. Flipping long would fight the intraday trend with no supporting evidence, and the wide 94 bp spread makes paying to exit on a failed poke at resistance unattractive.
